source_caption:
🎥🎬: Neagley

Frances Neagley, a highly skilled former military investigator and one of Jack Reacher’s closest allies, steps into the spotlight for her own story. After a shocking personal tragedy, Neagley discovers that someone from her past may have been targeted, forcing her to investigate a mystery that hits much closer to home than she expected.

Using her military training, intelligence, and ability to operate on her own, Neagley follows a trail of secrets and dangerous enemies. As the investigation unfolds, she reconnects with trusted allies and uncovers a conspiracy that goes far deeper than the original crime.

Now, Neagley has to rely on her instincts and everything she learned during her military career to uncover the truth, protect the people caught in the crossfire, and make sure those responsible are held accountable.

source_details.synopsis: Neagley () is an American action crime television series created by Nick Santora and Nicholas Wootton for Amazon Prime Video. Based on the character created by Lee Child, it is a spin-off of the television series Reacher. It stars Maria Sten, who reprises her role as Frances Neagley from Reacher, alongside Greyston Holt, Adeline Rudolph, Jasper Jones, Matthew Del Negro, and Damon Herriman. Neagley premiered its first season in its entirety on September 16, 2026. In October 2026, the series was renewed for a second season.
